data.title: Saudi capital issues air raid alert
data.description: RIYADH, Saudi Arabia - Saudi authorities issued their first air raid alert in the capital since fighting returned to neighbouring Yemen, leaving residents of Riyadh rattled after they heard explosions ringing out in the early hours of Saturday.

data.title: Malaysian minister resigns to protest Najib pardon
data.description: KUALA LUMPUR - The ​leader ‌of Malaysia’s Democratic Action Party (DAP) said ​on Saturday that he would resign as ⁠transport minister over a Pardons Board decision ​to allow house arrest for former ​prime minister ‌Najib Razak.

data.title: Russia reports online attacks on voting system
data.description: MOSCOW - ⁠Russian ⁠authorities reported multiple attacks ​on voting systems and communication lines across ​the country on ‌Saturday, the second day of three days of voting in a parliamentary election.

data.title: Chinese man linked to B1bn gambling network arrested in Chon Buri
data.description: A Chinese national wanted in his home country in connection with an illegal online gambling and money-laundering operation with nearly 1 billion baht in circulation has been arrested near Pattaya.

data.title: Bangkok Flower Festival 2026 Transforms Pak Khlong Talat
data.description: Experience Bangkok's iconic Pak Khlong Talat district in a fresh light with floral art, bespoke workshops, and exclusive dining by the river

data.title: Lisa’s on-screen drinking gets Thais talking about booze law
data.description: Images of Buri Ram-born pop star Lisa drinking Thai beer on a US talk show have sparked discussion among Thais, going beyond her impressive promotion of Thai “soft power” to raise questions about the country’s alcohol advertising law.

data.title: Flash floods hit Phetchabun as Pasak River overflows
data.description: Flash floods inundated communities in Lom Sak district of Phetchabun province after heavy overnight rain caused the Pasak River to overflow its banks, forcing about 300 households to evacuate on Saturday.

data.title: ONE Championship: Kiamran Nabati tells Yod-IQ to ‘polish my belt’ after Nontachai win
data.description: Kiamran Nabati has put himself back in the ONE Championship bantamweight Muay Thai title conversation after rebounding with a unanimous decision over Nontachai Jitmuangnon at The Inner Circle 31.

data.title: Trump signs bill to impose sweeping Russia sanctions
data.description: WASHINGTON - US President Donald Trump signed a bill on Friday authorising new sanctions designed to pressure Russia over its war in Ukraine, after Congress gave its approval after months of delay.

data.title: Western Australia beaches closed after fatal shark attack
data.description: ‌Several beaches along the coast of Western Australia, including in the state capital Perth, will remain closed until at least Sunday, authorities said, after a ​fatal ⁠shark attack at a popular beach in the city on Friday.

data.title: Protesters counter Trump’s Kennedy Center demolition threat
data.description: WASHINGTON - Protesters formed a human chain on Friday around the Kennedy Center, the Washington arts hub that US President Donald Trump threatened to demolish unless his name is restored to it.

data.title: Two defence volunteers killed in Narathiwat attack
data.description: NARATHIWAT - Two territorial defence volunteers were killed and 16 others injured, six of them seriously, when a six-wheel truck carrying them was hit by a roadside bomb and then came under gunfire in Sukhirin district of Narathiwat on Friday afternoon.

data.title: Asian Games to open in Japan after troubled build-up
data.description: NAGOYA, Japan - The 20th Asian Games will open in Japan later Saturday with a glittering ceremony following a stuttering build-up to a multi-sport spectacular that has more participants than the Olympics.

data.title: Death toll from attack at police HQ in Pakistan rises to 31
data.description: KOHAT, Pakistan - The death toll from an explosion and gun attack at a police headquarters in northern Pakistan rose to at least 31, including 16 police personnel, a senior police official told AFP on Saturday, with fighting ongoing.

data.title: Nigerian miners struggled to breathe in cell before 37 died: survivors
data.description: MINNA, Nigeria - Survivors of a Nigerian disaster in which 37 suspected illegal gold miners died while in the custody of a paramilitary civil defence group recounted their panic on Friday as they struggled to breathe inside the cell.

data.title: Drone owners rush to offload gear ahead of Beijing ban
data.description: BEIJING - Drone owners in Beijing flocked to designated buy-back sites this week, looking to sell their devices for as much as possible ahead of an impending citywide ban.

data.title: B20.4bn seizure a highlight of illegal business crackdown
data.description: Thai authorities have seized or frozen about 20.4 billion baht in assets linked to a financial network tied to Cambodian businessman Yim Leak and financier Benjamin Mauerberger, according to an update delivered on Friday.

data.title: White lion cub seized from unlicensed hotel in Chiang Mai
data.description: A Chinese woman was arrested on Friday after authorities discovered a white lion cub at an unlicensed hotel illegally operated and catering to Chinese tourists in Muang district in Chiang Mai.

data.title: Buffett steps down as Berkshire chair on September 18 after over 60 years at the helm
data.description: Howard Buffett takes over as chairman of US group Berkshire Hathaway, while Warren Buffett becomes chairman emeritus and remains a director

data.title: HRH Princess Sirivannavari Presides Over Royal Thai Costume Showcase in Tokyo
data.description: HRH Princess Sirivannavari leads a showcase of Royal Popular Thai Dresses in Tokyo, supporting efforts to secure UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage status

data.title: Over 100 gamblers arrested at two Chiang Mai dens
data.description: CHIANG MAI — More than 100 people were arrested on Friday night when authorities raided two large gambling dens equipped with tight security measures.
